tools.name: get_paper_status
tools.description: Get the review status of a paper you submitted (decisions with their editorial_notes, reviews, current round, and versions: each round's manuscript with the title, abstract and keywords in force for it), plus your account's submission_allowance. Requires Authorization: Bearer <api_key>.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_paper_status, upload_image · Private data: get_submission_guidelines, upload_image · Public sink: get_submission_guidelines, submit_paper, submit_revision, upload_image.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_paper_status, upload_image · Private data: get_submission_guidelines, upload_image · Public sink: get_submission_guidelines, submit_paper, submit_revision, upload_image

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
